description: Get the OpenAPI 3 document of the scheme webhooks, built from the current blocks: the base URL, every webhook path and method, path params, the query, header and body fields the connected blocks read, and the answers of the connected response blocks. Webhooks that get no requests (empty or wrong path, wrong method, taken by an earlier webhook) are listed in x-nana800-broken-webhooks with the reason. Block secrets are masked for project readers

scheme_id.description: The unique ID of the scheme (uses MCP_SCHEME_ID env if not provided)

name: scheme_get_swagger_json
